summary: IDC is looking for a Junior Data Engineer to join our TechMatch team in Bangalore, India. In this role, you will utilize cutting-edge cloud solutions to collect, import, load, clean, integrate, and process data from a variety of large datasets.
responsibilities: Collaborate closely with market analysts, domain experts, and data science teams to develop data models and cloud-based pipelines for market research, reporting, and generative AI use cases.
Use data to build and maintain up-to-date datasets that solve business problems, answer analytical questions, and improve processes.
Support scalable data sharing and integration best practices across systems and teams.
Define and implement metrics, guidelines, and strategies to ensure the effective use of data and algorithms.
Perform regular data validation and quality checks, identify data inconsistencies or gaps, and recommend corrective actions.
Design, build, and maintain ETL frameworks and infrastructure to collect, ingest, clean, integrate, and process data from multiple internal and external sources using SQL and AWS technologies.
required_skills: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology, Mathematics, or a related field.
1+ year of experience in data engineering or closely related roles.
Strong technical proficiency in object-oriented programming using Python.
Solid analytical skills with experience handling unstructured datasets.
Good working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
Ability to work independently and consistently deliver accurate, high-quality results on time.
nice_to_have_skills: Exposure to or experience with Machine Learning concepts or applications.
Experience with data engineering in cloud-based environments.
Familiarity with the AWS ecosystem and cloud services.
Hands-on experience with data platforms and tools such as Snowflake, PostgreSQL, Airflow, NoSQL databases, or distributed computing frameworks.
benefits: Equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons.
